decisions.question: Which huddle format do we pilot?
decisions.decision: Wins / Changes / Watch-fors / Asks / Dates, five minutes, start of shift
decisions.rationale: Short, predictable, and leaves room for questions.

feedback.summary: The Dates slot helped people remember the education sessions coming up.
Five minutes runs long when the Asks slot has more than three items; try capping Asks at three.
